test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 16th November 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: O, P, Q, R, S, T and U are sitting in a row facing north. U is sitting to the immediate right of T. Q is sitting in between R and O. P, who is on the extreme right, is sitting to the immediate right of O. S is sitting to the immediate left of R. Who is sitting in the middle of the row ?
solution:
The logic followed here is :-

1. O, P, Q, R, S, T and U are sitting in a row facing north.

2. __**P, who **__is on the extreme right, is sitting to the immediate right of O.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d21ffc13667e3c428280686773276cc40df587f518123d3faf2b450c198bcabc.png] 

3. Q is sitting in between R and O.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d9f879c4cdfc4fe7c8bc3922432f1160a7fe9a92f3997a6a7586562f47470072.png] 

4. S is sitting to the immediate left of R.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9f950c530fca8abca14c6b1df835247e36c84c36e28d5e0f352e13c453b07dc6.png] 

5. U is sitting to the immediate right of T.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8f02c469575cf0c93030c7da8c1571374680b34e43cd3dafa3cbdc9a3f49accd.png] 

∴ Here, 'R' is sitting in middle of the row.

Hence, the correct answer is **"R".**
